verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation of Namecheap's TLD catalog breadth, restricted-TLD rules, or country-code TLD requirements; the only tangential item (GetTldListWithContext API call) merely returns TLD capabilities programmatically but is not itself evidence of per-TLD restriction documentation or catalog breadth. missing for 10: list/count of supported TLDs, documented restricted-TLD requirements, country-code TLD-specific rules, any hands-on or docs confirmation of coverage breadth.
